dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a counselor. What can I help you with today?

dialogue.content: よろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: この前友達と喧嘩のような感じになってしまって
dialogue.English: The other day, I kind of got into a fight with a friend.

dialogue.content: おねがいいたします
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは心苦しいですね…
dialogue.English: That must be distressing...

dialogue.content: はい一方的におこられたかんじで
dialogue.English: Yes, it felt like I was being scolded one-sidedly.

dialogue.content: どうしてよいか
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: それはひどい…
dialogue.English: That's terrible...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなことで怒られたんですか？
dialogue.English: What did she get angry about?

dialogue.content: 学校のかえりに二人で帰っていたら
dialogue.English: We were walking home from school together,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: しらないおばさんにとつぜん同性愛者？ときかれて
dialogue.English: when a woman we didn't know suddenly asked, "Are you two lesbians?"

dialogue.content: いいえと言ったんだけど
dialogue.English: I said no, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: その後も彼女はずっとなんかおこっているから
dialogue.English: but after that, she kept seeming angry,

dialogue.content: どうして？そんなに怒っているの？
dialogue.English: I asked her, "Why? Why are you so angry?"

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ときいたらなんか余計怒り出して
dialogue.English: and when I asked that, she got even more upset,

dialogue.content: 勝手に先を歩いて行ってしまったんです
dialogue.English: and she just stormed off and walked ahead of me.

dialogue.content: なに？って感じで
dialogue.English: I was like, "What was that?"

dialogue.content: それは混乱してしまいますね…
dialogue.English: That must have been confusing...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私なにしたのかなと
dialogue.English: I wondered what I did wrong.

dialogue.content: 知らないおばさんが言ってきて、友達が怒ったという認識であってますか？
dialogue.English: So, to make sure I understand, a woman who was a stranger said something, and then your friend got angry. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はいそうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それは訳が分からないですよね…
dialogue.English: That must have made no sense...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも何か私が気に触ることをしたのだと
dialogue.English: But I feel like I must have done something to upset her.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: It's natural to think that way...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達には、その時のことについてどんな風に聞いたのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you ask your friend about what happened at that time?

dialogue.content: いつまでもプリプリしてるからどうしてそんなに怒っているの？と聞いただけです。
dialogue.English: She kept acting sulky, so I just asked her, "Why are you so angry?"

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 心配になりますよね。
dialogue.English: That would make you worry, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 聞いたら、お友達はなんと言っていましたか？
dialogue.English: When you asked, what did your friend say?

dialogue.content: それが、言ってくれなかったというか
dialogue.English: Well, she didn't really tell me.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 彼女がずっとぶつぶつおばさんのことを言っているので
dialogue.English: She just kept muttering about the woman,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: 私もいらっとしてたというか
dialogue.English: so I was getting a little irritated myself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: だから私の聞き方もキツかったとは思うんです
dialogue.English: So I think the way I asked might have been a bit harsh.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: おばさんの話もういいじゃんと思ってしまって
dialogue.English: I was thinking, "Enough about the woman already."

dialogue.content: 訳が分からなくていら立ってきますよね…
dialogue.English: It's frustrating when you don't understand what's going on...

dialogue.content: うーんそこまで怒られることかなと
dialogue.English: Hmm, I just wondered if it was something to get that angry about.

dialogue.content: 今少しお話を伺って確認なのですが、お友達が怒っているのがなぜなのかどうしたらいいのか、を一緒に考えていくということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Based on what you've told me so far, can I confirm that you'd like us to think together about why your friend is angry and what you can do about it?

dialogue.content: そうですねはいよろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Please, let's do that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ぜひ一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Let's definitely work on this together.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ。友達は、おばさんについてどんな風にいっていたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You're welcome. What was your friend saying about the woman?

dialogue.content: どうして、そんなこと聞いてくるの？
dialogue.English: Things like, "Why would she ask something like that?"

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: and things like that,

dialogue.content: へん
dialogue.English: "Weird,"

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: and things like that.

dialogue.content: そうですか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 気分が悪かったんだとは思うのですが
dialogue.English: I think she must have felt upset,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: 私はそんなに腹もたってなかったので
dialogue.English: but I wasn't that angry about it,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: そのままその話は流したかったというか
dialogue.English: so I kind of wanted to just let the topic drop.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その時の友達との気持ちにギャップがあったんですね…
dialogue.English: So there was a gap between how you felt and how your friend felt at that moment...

dialogue.content: すぐに忘れたかったような・・・
dialogue.English: I just wanted to forget about it right away...

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: そうですねギャップ
dialogue.English: Yes, a gap.

dialogue.content: だからどうしてそんなに怒っているの？と
dialogue.English: That's why I asked, "Why are you so angry?"

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんはおばさんに言われてどう思われたんですか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when the woman said that to you?

dialogue.content: かぶりましたね、ごめんなさいね
dialogue.English: Oh, we spoke at the same time, I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 特にあー違いますって感じ
dialogue.English: Not much, just like, "Oh, no, that's not right."

dialogue.content: 間違われたんだーくらい
dialogue.English: Just that she was mistaken.

dialogue.content: そうですか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: とつぜん聞いてくるのはびっくりしたけど
dialogue.English: I was surprised she asked so suddenly,

dialogue.content: そこまで
dialogue.English: but not to that extent.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それ以上する話じゃないなと
dialogue.English: I didn't think it was worth talking about any further.

dialogue.content: そっか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: お友達とは思いが違ったんですね…
dialogue.English: So you and your friend felt differently about it...

dialogue.content: そういうことなんですよね
dialogue.English: I guess that's what it was.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…
dialogue.English: Right...

dialogue.content: でも、それでそこまで怒る？のかな
dialogue.English: But, is that really something to get so angry about?

dialogue.content: 大切な友達だと不安になるし理解してあげたいって思いますよね…
dialogue.English: When it's an important friend, you feel anxious and want to understand them, don't you...

dialogue.content: お友達とはいつもはどんな関係なのですか？
dialogue.English: What is your relationship with your friend usually like?

dialogue.content: 普通に良いです一緒に帰るぐらいの関係だけど休日まで一緒にいることはないです。
dialogue.English: It's normally good. We're close enough to walk home together, but we don't hang out on weekends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも今回のことは気になってしまって
dialogue.English: But this time, it's really been bothering me.

dialogue.content: 私がどうして怒られるのか
dialogue.English: Like, why she's getting angry at me.

dialogue.content: ちなみに学校と言っていましたが、おいくつですか？(言えたらで大丈夫です)
dialogue.English: By the way, you mentioned school, how old are you? (Only if you're comfortable sharing).

dialogue.content: 高校1年です
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year in high school.

dialogue.content: 私は悪くないのになんでって思いますよね
dialogue.English: You must feel like, "Why, when I didn't do anything wrong?"

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing.

dialogue.content: 思いが違ったくらいで話もせずにどんどん先をいっちゃうなんて
dialogue.English: To just storm off without talking, just because we felt differently...

dialogue.content: びっくりというか
dialogue.English: I was shocked, I guess.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達と平日は学校でどんな関係ですか？
dialogue.English: What is your relationship like with your friend at school on weekdays?

dialogue.content: 驚きますね…
dialogue.English: It is surprising...

dialogue.content: クラスは違っているので、ずっと一緒にいるわけではないです
dialogue.English: We're in different classes, so we're not together all the time.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お友達になったきっかけとかはありますか？
dialogue.English: How did you become friends?

dialogue.content: 通学の方向が一緒で時間も一緒だったのでいつのまにかという感じです
dialogue.English: We commute in the same direction at the same time, so it just kind of happened naturally.

dialogue.content: そうですか。それでしたら、一緒に帰ったり、たまたま会ったりすることも多そうですものね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, you probably walk home together or run into each other often.

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: どんな話をされるんですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of things do you talk about?

dialogue.content: 自分の趣味の話とか学校の話とか
dialogue.English: We talk about our hobbies, things about school, and so on.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: いろんな話をされるんですね
dialogue.English: So you talk about all sorts of things.

dialogue.content: 委員会いが一緒だったり、イギリス研修に行く時も一緒に行動することが多いですね
dialogue.English: We were on the same committee, and we often spent time together during the UK study trip.

dialogue.content: なにか行事の時に協力し合うことが多い関係です
dialogue.English: We're the kind of friends who often help each other out during events.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 心強い仲間なんですね
dialogue.English: So she's a reassuring companion.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さんはお友達のことをどんな風に思っていますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about your friend?

dialogue.content: はいやっぱり頼り甲斐があって気があって一緒にいても楽しいだからこそあまり険悪な関係になりたくなかった
dialogue.English: Yes, she's reliable, we get along, and it's fun to be with her. That's exactly why I didn't want to have a bad relationship with her.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: 大切なお友達なのですね…
dialogue.English: She's a very important friend to you...

dialogue.content: はいちょうど良い関係でした
dialogue.English: Yes, it was just the right kind of relationship.

dialogue.content: ちょうど良いって、どんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by 'just right'?

dialogue.content: うーんとなんていうのかな
dialogue.English: Um, how should I put it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 気を使いすぎる必要もなくて相手も同じ感じだと思う
dialogue.English: We don't have to be overly considerate, and I think she feels the same.

dialogue.content: どっちが過度になってるわけでもなく
dialogue.English: Neither of us has to try too hard.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。お友達とはありのままの自分でいられたんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you could be your true self with your friend.

dialogue.content: だからこそ険悪は嫌ですよね…
dialogue.English: Which is why being on bad terms is so unpleasant...

dialogue.content: はいでも、よく不機嫌になることはあって
dialogue.English: Yes, but she does get into a bad mood often.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どんな時ですか？
dialogue.English: When does that happen?

dialogue.content: 相手が不機嫌になってしまうでいた
dialogue.English: She would just get into a bad mood.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 私はよくわかっていないので困るのですが
dialogue.English: I often don't understand why, which troubles me,

dialogue.content: だから、不機嫌になったときはちょっと気を使うようにしてはいました
dialogue.English: so when she gets into a bad mood, I try to be a bit more considerate.

dialogue.content: 今回みたいな怒られ方は初めてで
dialogue.English: But this is the first time she's gotten angry at me like this.

dialogue.content: 顔色をうかがっちゃいますね…
dialogue.English: You end up walking on eggshells...

dialogue.content: 基本は自分は鈍感な方だと思うのですが
dialogue.English: Basically, I think I'm the type who's not very sensitive,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: 相手が嫌だと思うことはしたくはないけど
dialogue.English: and I don't want to do things she dislikes, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 不機嫌にさせてしまった時は申し訳ない気持ちもあるけど
dialogue.English: when I do make her upset, I feel sorry, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そもそも不機嫌になる理由がわからないことがあって’
dialogue.English: sometimes I just don't understand the reason she's upset in the first place.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: 私自身も正直気分がよくないことがあるんです
dialogue.English: To be honest, it sometimes makes me feel bad too.

dialogue.content: それはそうですよね…
dialogue.English: Of course it would...

dialogue.content: 最後には腹が立ってきますよね
dialogue.English: Eventually, it can even make you angry.

dialogue.content: 直接なんで？等聞いたりするんですか？
dialogue.English: Do you ever ask her directly, like "Why?"

dialogue.content: 聞く時は聞きます
dialogue.English: Sometimes I do.

dialogue.content: (すみません…10時半くらいまで大丈夫でしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (Excuse me... would it be all right if we continue until about 10:30?)

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございます。進めます)
dialogue.English: (Thank you. Let's continue.)

dialogue.content: そしたらお友達はどんな風に言うんですか？
dialogue.English: And when you do, what does your friend say?

dialogue.content: べつにとかではっきり答えてくれません
dialogue.English: She doesn't give a clear answer, just says something like "It's nothing."

dialogue.content: だからほとんどわからないままです
dialogue.English: So I'm mostly left in the dark.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは不安に思いますね
dialogue.English: That must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.content: ほんと私も悪いとはおもうのですがわからないものはわからない
dialogue.English: Really, I feel like it might be my fault, but if I don't know, I just don't know.

dialogue.content: それは本当にそうですよね…
dialogue.English: That's absolutely true...

dialogue.content: 話戻りますが、おばさんのことはいつ頃のことですか？
dialogue.English: Going back to what we were talking about, when did this incident with the woman happen?

dialogue.content: おとといです
dialogue.English: The day before yesterday.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今日と昨日は用事があると言われて一緒に学校行っていません
dialogue.English: Yesterday and today, she said she had things to do, so we didn't go to school together.

dialogue.content: それでさすがに本気で怒っているのかなと
dialogue.English: So that made me think she must be really angry.

dialogue.content: それはモヤモヤが残ってしまいますね
dialogue.English: That must leave you with a lot of unresolved feelings.

dialogue.content: はい謝った方がいいかなとおもうものの
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm wondering if I should apologize, but...

dialogue.content: おばさん事件から会っていないのですね
dialogue.English: So you haven't seen her since the incident with the woman.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話割りました…おもうもののの続き、お話しくださいね
dialogue.English: I interrupted you... please continue with what you were saying about "wondering if you should apologize, but..."

dialogue.content: あーすみません少しずれますが彼女がおばさんに腹を立ててる時に私は一言そう言われても仕方ないんじゃない？みたいなことは言った気がします
dialogue.English: Oh, sorry, this is a bit off-topic, but when she was getting angry at the woman, I think I said something like, "Well, can you blame her for saying that?"

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。なんでおばさんはそう言ってきたと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Why do you think the woman said that?

dialogue.content: 二人の距離が近かった？みたいでうs
dialogue.English: Maybe because we were walking close together?

dialogue.content: おばさんに手繋いでいるようにみえたと言われました
dialogue.English: The woman said it looked like we were holding hands.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それだけ仲がいいんですね
dialogue.English: That shows how close you two are.

dialogue.content: ご相談者さん、今までのお話しをまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if I summarize what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はいお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: おととい、あるおばさんに言われたことでお友達と険悪になっていることを悩んでらっしゃいます
dialogue.English: You're troubled because you're on bad terms with your friend over something a woman said the day before yesterday.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までも機嫌は悪くなることもあったけど、今回みたいに怒ることは初めてで
dialogue.English: She has been in a bad mood before, but this is the first time she's gotten angry like this.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 気持ちが理解できず悶々とされています
dialogue.English: You're feeling distressed because you can't understand her feelings.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 高校の帰り道や行きに出会うこともあり、お友達のことを大切に思ってらっしゃいますね。
dialogue.English: You often see each other on the way to and from high school, and you cherish your friend very much.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 距離が近かったからそう思われたのかもしれないけど、そんなに怒らなくても…と思い、それからお会いしていないとのことですね
dialogue.English: You think the woman might have thought that because you were close, but you feel your friend didn't need to get that angry, and you haven't seen each other since.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はいそうですそうは思っていましたが自分は特に強く怒ってはいないです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. I did think that, but I wasn't particularly angry myself.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 不思議に思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It makes you wonder, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: でも彼女にとっては
dialogue.English: But for her...

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話しできることからで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: It's okay to start with whatever you feel comfortable talking about.

dialogue.content: おばさんのことも、彼女のことも腹をたててたわけではなかったです
dialogue.English: I wasn't really angry at the woman or at my friend.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうですか、どんな気持ちだったんですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, how were you feeling then?

dialogue.content: 不思議？というか
dialogue.English: Puzzled? I guess.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: 今は疑問と不満と不安
dialogue.English: Right now, it's confusion, frustration, and anxiety.

dialogue.content: 今はこれからどうしようかと不安が強いです
dialogue.English: Right now, I'm mostly anxious about what to do from here.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 大切に思うからこそそんな風に思うのも無理ないと思います…
dialogue.English: It's only natural to feel that way, precisely because you care about her...

dialogue.content: 嫌われたくはないです
dialogue.English: I don't want her to dislike me.

dialogue.content: おとといからとても悶々とされていたと思います
dialogue.English: You must have been feeling very distressed since the day before yesterday.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とてもつらかったですね
dialogue.English: That must have been very hard for you.

dialogue.content: はい怖くなってきました
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm starting to get scared.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…伺って私が思ったことをお伝えしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... May I share a thought I had while listening to you?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんはお友達思いのとてもやさしく誠実な方だと思いました
dialogue.English: I felt that you are a very kind and sincere person who cares deeply for your friend.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お友達が機嫌が悪くなる時もなお友達の気持ちを理解しようとされている
dialogue.English: Even when your friend is in a bad mood, you still try to understand her feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですね知りたいです
dialogue.English: That's right, I want to know.

dialogue.content: とても思いやりのある、お友達思いの方だなと思いました
dialogue.English: I thought you were a very considerate and thoughtful friend.

dialogue.content: そうありたいとは思っています
dialogue.English: I hope to be.

dialogue.content: 一方でお友達の感情に左右されていることが少なからずあるかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: On the other hand, you might be somewhat influenced by your friend's emotions.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね気がつけば気になってしまいます
dialogue.English: That's true. Before I know it, I'm worrying about it.

dialogue.content: 大切なお友達ですもの
dialogue.English: She is your dear friend, after all.

dialogue.content: 当然のことですよね
dialogue.English: That's perfectly natural.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここはご提案なのですが
dialogue.English: I have a suggestion, if I may.

dialogue.content: 今の状況から抜け出せるよう一緒に考えていければと思います
dialogue.English: I'd like us to think together about how you can get out of this current situation.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はいおねがいします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お友達は何を考えているか知りたいとのことでしたが
dialogue.English: You said you want to know what your friend is thinking.

dialogue.content: 人の本当の気持ちは本人にしかわからないのかもしれません
dialogue.English: However, perhaps only that person can truly know their own feelings.

dialogue.content: そこで、提案なのですが
dialogue.English: So, my suggestion is—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 休日は一緒にいることがないとのことでしたので
dialogue.English: You mentioned you don't spend time together on weekends,

dialogue.content: たまには二人でお出かけしてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: so how about going out together, just the two of you, for a change?

dialogue.content: 彼女の好きなことなどありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything she likes to do?

dialogue.content: なるほど…それはなぜですか？
dialogue.English: I see... Why do you suggest that?

dialogue.content: 食べ物・場所など
dialogue.English: Foods, places, that sort of thing.

dialogue.content: カラオケ？
dialogue.English: Karaoke?

dialogue.content: かな
dialogue.English: Maybe.

dialogue.content: 好きなものを共有すると
dialogue.English: When you share something you both enjoy,

dialogue.content: カラオケですか！
dialogue.English: Karaoke!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 好きなものを共有すると、今まで話してくれなかったことなども
dialogue.English: When you share something you enjoy, she might open up about things she hasn't talked about before.

dialogue.content: 話してくれることがあります
dialogue.English: Sometimes they open up and talk.

dialogue.content: いつもは学校でも別のクラスで
dialogue.English: Usually, you're in different classes at school,

dialogue.content: 行きかえり、委員会、学校関係が多いい二人だから
dialogue.English: and your interactions are mostly related to commuting, committees, and school,

dialogue.content: 大切に思っているからこそ
dialogue.English: precisely because you care about her,

dialogue.content: あえて【学校ではない二人】を演出してみるのもいいかもしれません
dialogue.English: it might be a good idea to purposefully create a "you two, outside of school" situation.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そういう考えもあるのですね
dialogue.English: I see—that's one way to think about it.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やってみたい気持ちはあるのですが、今の状況だと誘いにくいのですが
dialogue.English: I feel like I'd want to try, but it's hard to ask her, given the current situation.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: なんて声掛けすれば
dialogue.English: What should I say to her?

dialogue.content: その前にまずは
dialogue.English: Before that, perhaps first,

dialogue.content: 今避けられてるし
dialogue.English: She's avoiding me right now.

dialogue.content: 【何で怒ったか】よりも【あなたを大切に思っている】をlineなどで伝えるのもいいかも
dialogue.English: Instead of asking 'Why were you angry?', it might be good to convey via text that you value her as a friend.

dialogue.content: あなたのことを頼り甲斐があって気があって一緒にいても楽しいって思っている
dialogue.English: Something like, "I think you're reliable, we get along, and I have fun when I'm with you."

dialogue.content: ってあえていうのですか？なんか恥ずかしいですが
dialogue.English: You mean say that outright? It's a little embarrassing.

dialogue.content: だからあなたのことを理解したいって思う
dialogue.English: And, "That's why I want to understand you."

dialogue.content: など、あえて伝えてみる
dialogue.English: Try saying things like that intentionally.

dialogue.content: なかなか勇気がいりますね
dialogue.English: That takes a lot of courage.

dialogue.content: そうですよね！はじめは勇気がいりますよね！人は時に思いは伝わっていると思いがちだけど
dialogue.English: It does! It takes courage at first. We sometimes tend to assume our feelings are understood, but

dialogue.content: 言葉で伝えないと伝わっていないことはすれ違いの原因になったりもします
dialogue.English: when we don't put things into words, it can lead to misunderstandings.

dialogue.content: そうですよね私もそう思います
dialogue.English: That's true, I think so too.

dialogue.content: 逆に本当の大切な思いを伝えると仲が深まったり
dialogue.English: On the other hand, conveying your true, important feelings can deepen your bond,

dialogue.content: 本音で話し合える関係にもなったり
dialogue.English: and lead to a relationship where you can speak honestly with each other,

dialogue.content: 逆にこの人とは違ったと思うこともあるかもしれません
dialogue.English: or, conversely, you might realize that you're just not compatible with this person.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね勇気を出してみた方が良さそうですね
dialogue.English: You're right. It seems like I should muster the courage and try.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: I'll do my best.

dialogue.content: そうですね！一歩勇気を出すと、違った一面が見えてくるかもしれませんね！
dialogue.English: Yes! If you take that one brave step, you might see a different side of things!

dialogue.content: 自分の思いは伝えてみようと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'll try to convey my feelings.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: いつも彼女を大切に思うあなたの思い、きっと伝わると思いますよ
dialogue.English: I'm sure your feelings of always caring for her will get through.

dialogue.content: そうだと嬉しいです
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: お互いの思いが伝わりあえるよう願っています！
dialogue.English: I hope you can both communicate your feelings to each other!

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談されてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel after talking about this today?

dialogue.content: (ごめんなさい…時間が…)
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry... our time is...)

dialogue.content: はい自分の思いをつたえてはいなかったので、たしかにと思いました
dialogue.English: Yes, I realized that I hadn't been conveying my own feelings, so that really resonated with me.

dialogue.content: お時間ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: 大切なお友達と一歩前進できることを願っています。
dialogue.English: I hope you can take a step forward with your dear friend.

dialogue.content: はい頑張ります
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll do my best.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談に来てくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
